title: Co-delivery of loaded 4-butylresorcinol and licochalcone A in a supramolecular system for synergistic permeation and whitening effects.
authors: Lu, Beibei; Zhang, Tao; Liu, Yue; Shi, Xuefang; Wang, Yimeng; Ruan, Bo; Zhang, Jiaheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究美白活性成分的超分子递送系统，涉及黑色素相关蛋白表达抑制，但无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: As people age and are exposed to the sunlight for a long time, the excessive production and accumulation of melanin in the skin can affect their appearance and health. In addition, some whitening active ingredients have limitations in terms of solubility, stability, and skin irritation, which prompted us to research more effective techniques to improve the skincare effects of active ingredients. 4-Butylresorcinol (BR) can achieve whitening by inhibiting the activity of tyrosinase (TYR) and dihydroxyindole carboxylate oxidase. However, the high irritancy of BR limits its application. Therefore, we prepared supramolecular BR-LicoA-VE by intermolecular forces from BR, licoricarketone A (LicoA), and vitamin E acetate (VE). Compared with single BR, supramolecular BR-LicoA-VE exhibits good skin permeability and stability at room temperature, significantly reduces skin melanin content (30.55%), and inhibits the activity of TYR (59.90%). Through simulation calculations, it was found that supramolecular BR-LicoA-VE can inhibit the production of melanin in cells by suppressing the expression of melanin-related proteins such as TYR, endothelin-1, mammalian target of rapamycin, and microphthalmia-associated transcription factor. In the human experiments, a formula containing supramolecular BR-LicoA-VE shows better skin whitening effects after 28 days of use, with the lowest melanin content and the highest whiteness value (increased by 8.95%). Therefore, supramolecular BR-LicoA-VE has potential application value in whitening and skincare.
abstract_zh: 随着人们年龄增长及长期暴露于阳光下，皮肤中黑色素的过度产生和积累会影响外观和健康。此外，一些美白活性成分在溶解性、稳定性和皮肤刺激性方面存在局限性，这促使我们研究更有效的技术来提升活性成分的护肤效果。4-丁基间苯二酚（BR）可通过抑制酪氨酸酶（TYR）和二羟基吲哚羧酸氧化酶的活性来实现美白效果。然而，BR的高刺激性限制了其应用。因此，我们通过分子间作用力从BR、甘草查尔酮A（LicoA）和维生素E醋酸酯（VE）制备了超分子BR-LicoA-VE。与单一BR相比，超分子BR-LicoA-VE在室温下表现出良好的皮肤渗透性和稳定性，显著降低皮肤黑色素含量（30.55%），并抑制TYR活性（59.90%）。通过模拟计算发现，超分子BR-LicoA-VE可通过抑制TYR、内皮素-1、哺乳动物雷帕霉素靶蛋白和小眼畸形相关转录因子等黑色素相关蛋白的表达来抑制细胞中黑色素的产生。在人体实验中，含有超分子BR-LicoA-VE的配方在使用28天后显示出更好的皮肤美白效果，黑色素含量最低，白度值最高（增加8.95%）。因此，超分子BR-LicoA-VE在美白护肤方面具有潜在的应用价值。
